text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, and Yaeno Muteki has come to watch Sakura Chiyono O, believing she might be a worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She believes finding a worthy opponent will help her improve, and through the act of refining herself, she'll be able to thank her grandfather, who helped her when she strayed off the righteous path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan is unable to come watch the race due to her doctor's orders… She seems to have quite a delicate constitution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for Sakura Chiyono O, her head is filled with thoughts of Maruzensky's previous win at the Asahi Futurity Stakes as she heads to the paddock.
